slides.title: Ethiopia presses UN envoy on Eritrea and Sudan
slides.body: Getachew Reda urged both to stop backing armed groups; both deny it, per Borkena.

slides.title: Jimma residents report arrests after protests
slides.body: Addis Standard: residents cite forced recruitment. Unverified; no official comment.

slides.title: Displaced families shelter in a school in Abi Adi
slides.body: Al Jazeera: families from Western Tigray; medicines reported scarce.
